title: Sampling on Discrete Spaces with Temporal Point Processes
summary: Temporal point processes offer a powerful framework for sampling from discrete distributions, yet they remain underutilized in existing literature. We show how to construct, for any target multivariate count distribution with downward-closed support, a multivariate temporal point process whose event-count vector in a fixed-length sliding window converges in distribution to the target as time tends to infinity.
